world.title: NATO summit: Trump declares Islamic Republic of Japan bombed US aircraft carrier
world.summary: During a NATO summit, President Donald Trump mistakenly referred to Iran as the "Islamic Republic of Japan" while discussing military issues with Volodymyr Zelenskyy. The comment quickly gained attention online as Trump intensified his rhetoric regarding Tehran, renewing military threats. This incident added to Trump's history of verbal gaffes, drawing significant media coverage and public reaction.

world.title: Indian techie kills wife in US four months after marriage, sends dead body's photograph to girlfriend; arrested
world.summary: Avinash Narne, a 30-year-old Indian engineer in the US, has been arrested for allegedly murdering his wife, Raajitha Sabbineni, 27, four months after their marriage. The incident occurred in June 2025, with Narne reportedly in a relationship with another woman. He allegedly sent a photograph of Sabbineni's body to his girlfriend. Charges of homicide have been filed against him.

world.title: 'On every single one of their list': Trump claims Iran is plotting to assassinate him
world.summary: US President Donald Trump stated on Wednesday that Iran is plotting to assassinate him, claiming he is "on every single one of their list." He accused Tehran of wanting to target US leadership. Trump's remarks come amid heightened tensions between the US and Iran, reflecting ongoing concerns regarding security and potential threats from the Iranian government.

business.title: Anthropic hits back after China warns of Claude Code ‘backdoor’ risks
business.summary: Anthropic, a US AI firm, responded to China's warning about security risks in its Claude Code product, stating that users in China were never authorized to use it. Beijing had advised the uninstallation of Claude Code due to concerns over potential "backdoor" vulnerabilities in older versions. Anthropic clarified that the product was not intended for the Chinese market.

business.title: Forex Today: US Dollar struggles despite hawkish FOMC Minutes
business.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY) is trading around 101.00 as investors analyze the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) Minutes from the June 16-17 meeting, the first under Chair Kevin Warsh. Despite a hawkish tone in the minutes, the dollar struggles to gain traction. Market participants are closely monitoring economic indicators and potential impacts on monetary policy.

business.title: India’s $100 Billion Grid Bet Is Accelerating A Solar Manufacturing Boom
business.summary: India is experiencing a significant solar energy expansion, adding a record 44 GW in 2025/26. This shift marks a departure from its previous reliance on coal for industrialization. The government’s commitment to a $100 billion grid initiative is driving a boom in solar manufacturing, transforming the energy landscape and increasing the country’s capacity for renewable energy production.

technology.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-Live and GPT-Live-1 mini: Full-Duplex Voice Models That Delegate Deeper Reasoning to GPT-5.5
technology.summary: OpenAI has launched GPT-Live, a new family of full-duplex voice models that can listen and speak simultaneously while delegating deeper reasoning tasks to GPT-5.5. This technology enhances the ChatGPT Voice experience, aiming for more natural, real-time conversations with AI. The initial release includes two versions: GPT-Live-1 and GPT-Live-1 mini, designed for varied applications.

technology.title: Physical media is about to have its biggest boom in years
technology.summary: Sony has announced it will cease production of physical discs for PlayStation consoles starting January 2028. This decision is expected to significantly impact the video game industry, raising concerns about the future of physical media. As digital distribution becomes more prevalent, the shift may inadvertently lead to a resurgence in physical media, challenging the dominance of digital formats.

technology.title: Assassin’s Creed: Black Flag Resynced boasts unique ship combat in an unmatched world
technology.summary: Assassin’s Creed: Black Flag Resynced returns with enhanced visuals and unique ship combat, inviting players to revisit its expansive world. Originally released in 2014, the game aims to compete with upcoming titles like Grand Theft Auto 6. Fans can expect familiar gameplay elements alongside improved graphics, rekindling the excitement of swashbuckling adventures on the high seas.

sports.title: Norway manager reveals Martin Odegaard tactical tweak from Arteta's Arsenal system ahead of England World Cup clash
sports.summary: Norway manager discussed Martin Odegaard's tactical adjustments influenced by Mikel Arteta's Arsenal system ahead of the World Cup match against England. Odegaard noted a quieter atmosphere in the Arsenal WhatsApp group leading up to the game. He will captain the Norwegian team, continuing his role from the season, as they prepare for the significant clash on Saturday.

sports.title: OCI players are foreigners, Indian striker not mandatory, says AIFF
sports.summary: The All India Football Federation (AIFF) has reversed its earlier decision requiring clubs to include an Indian striker in their starting lineup. The AIFF stated that the choice to field an Indian striker will now be left to the clubs, allowing them more flexibility in selecting their players. This decision marks a significant change in the federation's policy.

sports.title: Bayern Munich star Michael Olise has overcome doubts about his mentality
sports.summary: Bayern Munich's Michael Olise has silenced early doubts regarding his mentality and potential. Sky Sports expert Don Goodman praised Olise's development, highlighting that his rise to stardom was not initially guaranteed. Goodman reflected on Olise's past struggles, emphasizing the player's growth and resilience, which have contributed to his current success with Bayern Munich and the French national team.

health.title: E coli-produced HPV vaccine effective against cancer-causing strains of HPV
health.summary: A new HPV vaccine produced using E. coli has shown effectiveness against cancer-causing strains of the virus. This vaccine is less expensive than existing options, potentially increasing vaccination rates among women globally. Additionally, a recent study published in Pediatrics confirms that the antiviral drug Paxlovid is safe for children aged 6 and older, combining nirmatrelvir and ritonavir.

health.title: Gleneagles Hospital helps brain cancer patient to recover through indigenous CAR-T cell therapy
health.summary: Gleneagles Hospital Chennai has successfully treated a 49-year-old patient diagnosed with a rare and life-threatening form of brain lymphoma using indigenous CAR-T cell therapy. This advanced treatment led to the patient's full recovery. The hospital's clinical team, led by Senior Consultant V. Arun Ramanan, utilized innovative techniques to address the patient's condition effectively, marking a significant medical achievement.

health.title: Bangladesh measles outbreak worsens with another three dead bringing total tally of confirmed and related deaths to 745
health.summary: Bangladesh's measles outbreak has intensified, with three additional child fatalities reported in the last 24 hours, bringing the total number of confirmed and suspected measles-related deaths to 745. The situation highlights the ongoing public health crisis as authorities continue to address the rising incidence of measles-like symptoms among the population. Efforts to control the outbreak are ongoing.

science.title: Artemis II astronauts reunite with their moonship 3 months after record-breaking flight
science.summary: The Artemis II astronauts, including three from NASA and one Canadian, reunited with their capsule three months after setting a record for distance traveled during a lunar fly-around, covering 252,756 miles (406,771 kilometers). This mission marked humanity's first trip to the moon in over 50 years, showcasing advancements in space exploration and international collaboration.

science.title: Artificial cloud brightening could tame El Nino, but with risks: Study
science.summary: A study indicates that artificially brightening marine clouds in the Pacific may mitigate the effects of an impending "Super" El Niño, which is expected to cause global heat waves, floods, and droughts exacerbated by climate change. Researchers warn, however, that this technology carries potential risks and uncertainties, emphasizing the need for careful consideration before implementation.

science.title: Ancient quasars deepen the mystery of supermassive black hole formation
science.summary: The Euclid space telescope has identified 31 ancient quasars, including the earliest known, prompting new inquiries into the formation of supermassive black holes following the Big Bang. Quasars, among the universe's most luminous objects, represent supermassive black holes actively consuming matter at galaxy centers. These discoveries challenge existing theories about black hole growth in the early universe.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: Daily astrological predictions for July 9, 2026
entertainment.summary: Daily horoscope predictions for July 9, 2026, are available, detailing astrological events and influences for each of the 12 zodiac signs. An astrologer has analyzed planetary movements and alignments to provide insights into how these factors may affect individuals. Readers can explore specific guidance tailored to their zodiac signs based on the current astrological landscape.

entertainment.title: Dhamaal 4 Advance Booking: Ajay Devgn's comedy drama sells 8,000 tickets in National Chains, needs better momentum ahead
entertainment.summary: Ajay Devgn's comedy drama Dhamaal 4, directed by Inder Kumar, has sold approximately 8,000 tickets in national chains since advance bookings opened on Wednesday. The film is set to release this weekend, and while the initial response is considered decent, there is a need for improved momentum in ticket sales as the release date approaches.

entertainment.title: Bombay High Court Orders Removal Of Preity Zinta Deepfake Videos, Directs Meta, Google To Act
entertainment.summary: The Bombay High Court ordered Meta, Google, and other platforms to remove AI-generated deepfake videos of actress Preity Zinta. The court found that the unauthorized use of her image violated her personality, publicity, and moral rights. Justice Madhav J. Jamdar noted Zinta established a prima facie case for interim protection against the creation and circulation of such content.
